coldcard_2026.summary: Jul 30 2026. Coldcard hardware wallet RNG integration error (deterministic MicroPython Yasmarang fallback instead of STM32 hardware RNG; ~40-72 bit entropy). Attackers regenerated weak seeds offline and swept funds. Wave 1: 1,082.65 BTC from 1,196 addresses in 41 min (blocks 960,183-960,191). Total across waves: >=1,778 BTC from >8,600 addresses.
